results.modern_name: torsion (division) values of the lemniscatic elliptic function
results.usually_credited_to: Gauss (lemniscate studies 1797-98, Werke III/X); Abel 1827-28 for the general division theory

results.modern_name: a symmetric function of 7-division values lying in Q(sqrt 7) (class-field / complex-multiplication arithmetic of Q(i))
results.usually_credited_to: general theory: Abel (1828), Kronecker, Weber; this specific identity is not standard

It is consistent with what historians already attribute to him, not a new major result.
